summary: Independent verification of Fase 6 Stripe-only monetization. Created backend/tests/test_payments.py (11 tests, all passed) covering packages list, checkout (valid/invalid pacote), status endpoint, cross-user security, and webhook signature rejection. Frontend E2E via Playwright covering: header 'Buy credits' link -> /comprar-creditos page (balance + 3 correct package cards) -> Buy button redirect to real checkout.stripe.com hosted page (Sandbox badge, correct product name 'CoWriter — Conto/novela curta (40 créditos)', correct price R$29,90) -> cancel flow (/pagamento/cancelado shows message + Try again button, links back correctly) -> i18n verified in en and es locales for /comprar-creditos (fully translated, no raw keys) -> mobile viewport (375px) package cards stack correctly without overlap. Did not repeat the full card-payment E2E since main agent already confirmed reproducibility; did confirm checkout session creation + redirect works live.

ui_bugs.issue: On 375px mobile viewport, header content (credit balance pill + 'Buy credits' + History + language selector + logout) overflows container causing horizontal page scroll (body scrollWidth=459px vs 375px viewport). Language selector dropdown is cut off/partially hidden. This is a pre-existing header crowding issue made worse by adding the new 'Buy credits' link.

issues: Horizontal overflow / clipped language selector due to too many nav items in a single row

action_items: Fix Header.jsx mobile layout to prevent horizontal overflow at 375px width (e.g. move secondary nav items like History/language selector into a mobile menu, or use flex-wrap)
critical_code_review_comments: payments.py is clean and correct: PACOTES server-side authoritative, atomic UPDATE...RETURNING guard in _credit_payment correctly prevents double-crediting on webhook replay, cross-user ownership enforced via WHERE user_id=$2 in status query.
Webhook handler correctly rejects invalid/missing stripe-signature with 400 before touching DB - verified no crediting occurs on spoofed webhook calls even when referencing a real pending session_id.

GET /payments/status also opportunistically calls stripe.checkout.Session.retrieve as a fallback credit path if webhook is delayed/missed - reasonable resilience, wrapped in try/except for StripeError.
No issues found in schemas.py PaymentCheckoutCreate (simple pacote+origin_url), i18n locale files all have complete 'payments' namespace across all 7 locales.

AnalysisResult.jsx and AnalysisConfirmModal.jsx CTAs correctly gated on sem_credito / !saldo_suficiente conditions with correct data-testid and route (verified via code review, not live-triggered due to needing to deplete credits to zero).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passed; 1 pre-existing mobile header design issue found
